script.cover_1: A meeting is fixed right on your lunch break. Fair?
script.payoff: It may be needed once, and when it repeats, asking for another time is fair.
script.caption: Lunch is also work time, because you work better after it. Send this to the colleague who eats at the desk.
script.situation: Can a meeting be fixed during your lunch break?
script.answer: It may be needed once in a while. When it repeats, asking for another time is fair.
script.reply_me: Could we move this to 2 pm? I would like to take my lunch first and join fresh.
